name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション ドロロロボMk-II
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Dororo Robo Mk-II

description.ja: 遂に5体目のMk-IIロボ“ドロロロボMk-II”登場。
description.en: Finally, the fifth Mk-II robot “Dororo Robo Mk-II” appears.

description.ja: ロボ形態からドリルマシン形態へ変形。
description.en: Transforms from robot form to drill machine form.

description.ja: ロボに乗り込むドロロ兵長も手足が可動。
description.en: Corporal Dororo who rides the robot also has movable limbs.

description.ja: ドロロ兵長はロボのコクピットにもなるソーサーに乗せることが可能。
description.en: Corporal Dororo can be placed on a saucer that also serves as the robot's cockpit.

description.ja: 武器はドロロ刀、盾が付属。
description.en: Weapons include a dororo sword and a shield.
